Commodore C. D. Edgar's Follow-up Force B in the destroyer escort Maloy (Lt. Cdr. F. D. Kellogg USNR), embarking the rest of the 1st and 29th Divisions and V Corps and engineer special units (Maj. Gen. C. H. Gerhardt). Convoys (named in Morison, no group numbers in the sources, so no units): B-1 (Capt. J. R. Johannesen in LST-577; escort destroyer Rodman, HMS Brissenden and Wensleydale), B-2 (Cdr. T. F. Cameron in LCI-414; destroyer Ellyson, HMCS Kitchener and HMS Azalea), B-3 (Cdr. T. W. Harry Sanders in Frankford with the destroyers and destroyer escorts of the Escort and Bombardment Groups, PCs and SCs, and 12 PT of MTBron 34 under Lt. Cdr. John D. Rear Admiral Morton L. Deyo's bombardment force for the attack on Cherbourg on 25 June 1944 (VII Corps assault), two bombardment groups and two minesweeper units (Morison, Invasion of France and Germany (History of US Naval Operations vol. XI), Appendix I; Wikipedia 'Bombardment of Cherbourg' and dday-overlord.com 'Combined Task Force 129'). Groups: US-TG-129-1 (Deyo) and US-TG-129-2 (Bryant). Sweeper units (no numbers in the sources, so no units): Unit 1 (Cdr. R. W. N. Thomson RN) HMS Sidmouth, Bridlington, Eastbourne, Boston, Bangor, Blackpool, Tenby and Bridport with 4 danlayers, 4 ML, 8 BYMS (chunk 2/3); Unit 2 (Cdr. Henry Plander) the 8 US fleet minesweepers Pheasant, Threat, Broadbill, Chickadee, Auk, Staff, Raven and Swift with 4 ML and the British danlayer Thunder, assigned to this record directly. Wikipedia 'Bombardment of Cherbourg' also names Nuthatch among the sweepers of Group 2, which Morison does not (discrepancy; Nuthatch's own page says she swept for TF 129). Parent: Task Force 122 (US-TG-122). Group 1 of the Cherbourg Bombardment Force (US-TG-129), Rear Admiral Morton L. Deyo in Tuscaloosa: Quincy, Nevada, HMS Glasgow and Enterprise; destroyer screen under Capt. A. F. Converse (Comdesron 10) in Ellyson with Hambleton, Rodman, Emmons, Gherardi and Murphy (Morison App. I; Wikipedia 'Bombardment of Cherbourg' gives the same six destroyers and names Ellyson as flag; dday-overlord.com lists five, without Murphy).
